target: fixed-package preview only, English EN view when the tested control is pressed
setup: Each independent case starts with cleared output/selection and no Shift latch; finger only. Restore English EN view after a mode/layout case. Chinese ni is fixture setup for an EN-paused Esc test, not CN layer coverage.

keys.label: Tab
keys.baseCase: English EN: type a, tap Tab, type b; preview displays a⇥b (one literal tab)
keys.shiftCase: English EN: type a, tap Shift then Tab, type b; preview displays a⇥b (one literal tab)
keys.actual: 按该组步骤反馈正常，未另行转录

keys.label: Esc
keys.baseCase: Clear output; Chinese variable ni then switch to English EN, tap Esc: paused composition cleared and output stays empty
keys.shiftCase: Repeat same ni-to-English setup; tap Shift then Esc: composition cleared and output stays empty
keys.actual: 按该组步骤反馈正常，未另行转录

keys.label: CN EN
keys.baseCase: From English EN with no composition tap CN EN: Chinese; tap again: English; no output
keys.shiftCase: From English EN with no composition tap Shift then CN EN: Chinese; tap CN EN again: English; no output
keys.actual: 按该组步骤反馈正常，未另行转录

keys.label: Layout
keys.baseCase: While input language English with EN key view tap Layout: original key view; tap again: EN; geometry/colors retained, no output
keys.shiftCase: While input language English with EN view tap Shift then Layout: original key view; tap Layout again: EN; no output
keys.actual: 按该组步骤反馈正常，未另行转录

note: Preview Tab always inserts a literal tab; Word/Edge focus movement is independent. CN EN couples language/punctuation, Layout only changes English view preference. Empty alternate Shift actions use base-action fallback. Functional pass does not close the old static CN EN display usability failure.
